# Greenlit

> Is your AI-built app safe to launch? Greenlit grades a deployed web app (built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit, Emergent or by hand) from A to F for what a stranger can use against it, explains each problem in plain words, and gives a prompt to paste back into the app builder that fixes it. Made by Priberry. Free and open source (Apache-2.0).

- Web: https://greenlit.priberry.com (paste an address; reads only what every visitor can see)
- CLI: `npx greenlitlab myapp.lovable.app` · own app, with database checks: `npx greenlitlab myapp.lovable.app --mine`
- MCP server: `npx -y greenlitlab mcp`, one tool, `greenlit_check`
- Source: https://github.com/priberry-data/greenlitlab

## What it checks
- Secret keys (30 kinds: Stripe, OpenAI, OpenRouter, AWS, Supabase secret keys and more) in the JavaScript every visitor downloads
- A Supabase service_role key in the browser
- Supabase tables and Firebase data anyone can read (with --mine only; counts and names, never data)
- Source maps, clickjacking, missing security headers
- With --mine: open sign-up without email confirmation, storage buckets anyone can list, public .env files and .git folders
